title: Ledger Entry (v1)
description: One immutable REVISION of a ledger entry. The entity is identified by entryId; every write (create or edit) is a new droplet -- the by-id pointer resolves the current revision, and the full droplet chain is the version history / audit trail / undo. No UPDATE, no migrations, no versions table: immutability gives you all three for free.

entryId.description: Stable entity id (UUIDv7, auto-generated). Identifies the entry across every revision.

authorName.description: Display name of who wrote this revision. NOT named 'author' -- {{.author}} is a platform-reserved write-author template var (renders bolt:<boltId>); see AGENTS.md gotcha.

status.description: Lifecycle status. A status change is just a new revision -- the transition is in the history.

encrypted.description: True when body holds CLIENT-SIDE ciphertext (zero-knowledge). The server stores it opaquely and can never read it; the client prompts for the passphrase to decrypt. Tags stay plaintext so the AI can still find the entry.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the FIRST revision. Carried forward unchanged on every edit.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of THIS revision (null on the first).

revisionNote.description: Optional human note describing what changed in this revision (e.g. 'restored from 3 versions ago').

attachment.description: Optional file attachment (base64 for inline; large files use reserveDirectUpload). Floated + stripped. revisions:true means EVERY uploaded version is retained + independently downloadable at ver/<attachmentVersionId>/ -- the headline feature. The platform injects attachmentVersionId + the ver/ path segment; you author only revisions:true.

attachmentContentType.description: MIME type for the floated attachment.
